title: 第7章 被盯被揍算个球丑爷照样有办法第8章 夜璇迷烟放倒弄服
content_zh:
萧月娥截杀的第七天，护卫减半。
仙宫内听人言，说是损失了不少好手。
老丑自认以萧月娥之能断无可能。
这背后伸手的势力，老丑实在想不出谁还有如此实力。愿与当今玄天第一人为敌。
---香闺内，苏若雪秀眉轻皱。不见即将成婚喜悦。
面前半跪着一个黑衣少女。身材修长，面容清秀冰冷，有苏若雪五六分美丽。年不到二十，干练冷峻。
“前后不过七天，折了十队好手。”苏若雪轻声道，“姬昊天为坏我婚礼，也算是煞费苦心。”
黑衣少女应声道：“依属下看，玄天五寇逃脱定与那姬昊天脱不了干系。我闻五寇本就是其豢养之鹰犬！”
苏若雪轻言道：“不错，夜璇，你果然蕙质兰心。”她顿了顿。
“逸风哥哥虽欲退隐，但仍为十二大宗门总盟主。身处高位，太多眼睛盯着，欲急流勇退又谈何容易。”
“夜璇，你且将此信亲手送与太虚元君。路上带几个好手。顺便把那老丑也带上。我观其心思颇深，别有所图。我料至宝定与他有干系，现若杀之，恐至宝难归，你须一路盯死，若事无回旋之地，就地击杀，不得有误！““是。夜璇得令！“夜璇便要退去。
“且慢。此行，路途遥远，须格外小心谨慎，你我虽名为主仆，实则姐妹。”
“来人，取我仙宫至宝，碧水剑来！”
夜璇跪伏道：“敢不为主上效死！”
待得夜璇离开。
苏若雪眼中闪过一丝冷光，望你莫叫我失望！
随即又轻叹一声，低语道：“你个呆子。天天说要给你表妹治病，多少天没来看我了？”
---老丑这几日修炼，方知自己堪堪迈入后天境。离先天、天人、神境，差之太远。
虽已融合了原身，故更须多加隐忍，心中打定主意。不推翻陈逸风前，绝不可让他人知晓其真实身份。
只待将来一鸣惊人，好让天下人知晓，我非老丑，乃是堂堂正正的锁仙宫嫡传正宗！

此时，仙宫大总管陆天放忽地走来：“去西门汇合，听令。“老丑赶忙施礼应道：“是。”
心中却暗道，来传令非是守备总管，竟然是大总管亲临，看来是有大事要办。但为何要找他呢？以自己微末之能，好生奇怪。而且如此一来不是耽误他那所谓一月抓回逃犯之约吗？
但也由不得他多想。若有犹豫，他毫不怀疑，陆天放会当场击杀自己！
随陆天放来到西门，几人站定。五男一女。五名男子精气内敛，内息绵长，均是不俗高手。
content_en:
On the seventh day of Xiao Yue'e's interception, the guard was reduced by half.
I heard people in the Immortal Palace say that many good players were lost.
Lao Chou thought that it was impossible for Xiao Yue'e to defeat him.
Lao Chou really can't think of anyone with such strength behind this force. I am willing to be the enemy of the number one person in Xuantian today.
---In the fragrant boudoir, Su Ruoxue frowned slightly. No joy in getting married.
A girl in black was half-kneeling in front of her. With a slender figure and a delicate and cold face, she is half as beautiful as Su Ruoxue. He is less than 20 years old, capable and cool.
"It only took seven days, but ten teams of good players were killed." Su Ruoxue said softly, "Ji Haotian took a lot of trouble to ruin my wedding."
The girl in black responded: "According to my opinion, the escape of Xuantian's five bandits must be related to that Ji Haotian. I heard that the five bandits are his eagle dogs!"
Su Ruoxue said softly: "Yes, Ye Xuan, you really have a beautiful heart." She paused.
"Although Brother Yifeng wants to retire, he is still the leader of the twelve major sects. He is in a high position and has too many eyes staring at him. It is not easy to retreat bravely."
"Yexuan, please hand-deliver this letter to Taixu Yuanjun. Bring a few good men with you on the way. Take that old ugly man with you as well. I see that he is very thoughtful and has other agendas. I suspect that the treasure must be related to him. If you kill him now, it will be difficult for the treasure to come back. You must keep an eye on him all the way. If there is no way around, kill him on the spot without making any mistakes!" "Yes. Ye Xuan has the order!" Ye Xuan was about to retreat.
"Wait a minute. This trip is a long one, so we must be extra careful. Although we are called masters and servants, we are actually sisters."
"Come here, take the most precious treasure of my fairy palace, the Blue Water Sword!"
Ye Xuan knelt down and said, "How dare you not die in service to the Lord!"
Wait until Ye Xuan leaves.
A cold light flashed in Su Ruoxue's eyes, I hope you won't disappoint me!
Then he sighed softly and whispered: "You idiot. You say you want to treat your cousin every day, but how many days have you not come to see me?"
---Old Chou has been practicing for the past few days, and he knows that he is ready to enter the acquired realm. It is too far away from the realm of innate, heavenly beings and gods.
Although he has merged with his original body, he must be more forbearing and make up his mind. Before Chen Yifeng is overthrown, others must not let others know his true identity.
I just want to make a big splash in the future, so that people in the world know that I am not an old and ugly person, but an upright and authentic descendant of Suoxian Palace!
At this time, Lu Tianfang, the general manager of the Immortal Palace, suddenly came over and said: "Go to the west gate to meet up and listen to the order." The old man quickly saluted and said, "Yes."
But he secretly thought that it was not the garrison manager who came to deliver the order, but the chief manager himself. It seemed that there was something big to do. But why look for him? With my little ability, I am so weird. And wouldn't this delay his so-called one-month agreement to capture the fugitive?
But he couldn't help but think too much. If there was any hesitation, he had no doubt that Lu Tianfang would kill him on the spot!
Following Lu Tianfang to the west gate, several people stood still. Five men and one woman. The five men have restrained energy and long inner breath, and they are all good masters.
